column3: MT 21:37. Close to the Hebrew.
MT 22:1. “bloodguiltiness” renders “bloods.”
MT 22:2. “bloodguiltiness” renders “bloods”; “shall surely make restitution” renders an emphatic doubled verb.
MT 22:3. Close to the Hebrew; “actually” renders a doubled verb.
MT 22:4. “lets … be grazed bare” renders a verb that may also mean “burn”; the meaning is uncertain.
MT 22:5. “shall surely make restitution” renders an emphatic doubled verb.
MT 22:6. Close to the Hebrew.
MT 22:7. “the judges” renders “ha-Elohim,” which may also mean God (also in verse 9); “to determine whether” renders the oath formula “if not.”
MT 22:8. “breach of trust” renders “matter of transgression.”
MT 22:9. “is driven away” renders “is captured,” and “while no one is looking” renders “there was none seeing.”
MT 22:10. “an oath before the LORD” renders “the oath of the LORD.”
MT 22:11. “actually” renders an emphatic doubled verb.
MT 22:12. “all torn to pieces” renders an emphatic doubled verb.
MT 22:13. “borrows” renders “asks,” and “make full restitution” renders an emphatic doubled verb.
MT 22:14. Close to the Hebrew.
MT 22:15. “engaged” renders “betrothed”; “he must pay a dowry” renders a doubled verb for paying the bride-price (mohar).
MT 22:16. “absolutely refuses” renders an emphatic doubled verb; “dowry” renders “bride-price.”
MT 22:17. Close to the Hebrew.
MT 22:18. “shall surely be put to death” renders an emphatic doubled verb.
MT 22:19. “any god” renders “the gods,” and “shall be utterly destroyed” renders “shall be devoted to destruction (herem).”
MT 22:20. “wrong” renders “maltreat.”
MT 22:21. Close to the Hebrew.
MT 22:22. “at all,” “does,” and “surely” render three emphatic doubled verbs.
MT 22:23. Close to the Hebrew.
MT 22:24. Close to the Hebrew.
MT 22:25. “If you ever” renders a doubled verb; “before the sun sets” renders “until the sun goes.”
MT 22:26. “his body” renders “his skin.”
MT 22:27. “God” renders “Elohim,” and “a ruler” renders “a nasi (leader).”
MT 22:28. “the offering from your harvest and your vintage” interprets “your fullness and your juice”; the meaning is uncertain.
MT 22:29. Close to the Hebrew.
